title: A Single Glance, Eternal as Time
content: One gaze, time stranded in the now
contentZh: 一眼凝眸，时光便在此刻搁浅。

title: Unexpected Encounter
content: What beats seeing friends after a long day?
contentZh: 还有什么比忙碌了一天之后见到朋友们更令人开心的。

title: A Quiet Moment of Dex
content: Dex is a good friend of ours who's been dropping by most weeks lately. One evening before the heat set in, I caught this shot of him — ended up being one of his favorites too.
contentZh: Dex是我们的老朋友，近来几乎每周都会来。入夏前的某个夜晚，我随手按下快门，没想到定格了他最松弛的样子——他自己看了，也说喜欢。

title: Sunny Saucy, Fifty Shades of Grey
content: This Friday night, come and have a drink or much more, with Matthew, our latest one-night host.
contentZh: 本周五晚上，我们将迎来一日店长马修，来和他一醉方休吧！

title: Untold Surprise
content: What I didn't mention—Yida, our old friend who moved to Australia, is back in town after all this time.
contentZh: 我故意没说的是，今天好久没见的移居澳洲的朋友益达回来啦！！非常开心！！

title: Happy Birthday
content: It's our best friend Robin's birthday. I'm sure it's not the right picture to post, but anyway haha.
contentZh: 今天是好朋友铁塔的生日，来一起祝他生日快乐吧！

title: Bubble Romance
content: I'm singing in the rain, and dancing in the rain.
